name: Catch Up!! ~Maketara Soku AV Debut!?~
original_name: Catch Up!! ～負けたら即AVデビュー!?～
source:
Six girls are gathered in a tropical island. All of them have a dream.
They need to win the game to make that dream come true.

If they can outrun from you, their dream will be real.
However, if they get caught, a cruel punishment awaits them.

Run, set traps, run away from a crazy woman and find a girl who are hiding here and there.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE054384.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
六个女孩聚集在一个热带岛屿上。他们都有一个梦想。
他们需要赢得比赛才能实现梦想。

如果他们能超越你，他们的梦想就会成真。
然而，一旦被抓住，等待他们的将是残酷的惩罚。

奔跑，设置陷阱，逃离一个疯狂的女人，找到一个躲在各处的女孩。

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE054384.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
